facts.orange-wheel: The large orange wheel in the center is engraved with the letters T, A, R, O alternating with Hebrew letters.
facts.inner-symbols: Inside the wheel's inner circle are alchemical symbols and eight spokes.
facts.sphinx-sword: At the top of the wheel sits a blue sphinx holding a sword upright.
facts.snake-left: On the left side of the wheel, a yellow snake goes downward.
facts.jackal-right: At the lower right of the wheel, a figure with a red animal head rises while supporting the wheel.
facts.four-creatures: On clouds in the four corners are a winged man, an eagle, a bull, and a lion, each holding an open book.
facts.cloud-sky: Gray clouds and blue sky fill the background.

glosses.orange-wheel: The flow of a situation that turns without stopping.
glosses.snake-left: What goes down and what comes up are on the same wheel.
glosses.four-creatures: Things that stay fixed in the four corners and keep learning even when the flow changes.

reversedGloss.blocked: The flow seems to have caught for a moment and stopped.
reversedGloss.waning: A stretch where a good flow has come around once and is now on its way down.

misdescriptions.wrong: A goddess is turning the wheel.
People are clinging to the wheel and going up and down.
